item.tib: zab mo bdud gcod gsang ba ye shes lnga'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa
item.coloph: gcod gdams dmigs rim thos tsam 'di/ bla med byang chub bsgrub brtson pa/ rdo rje spun grogs g.yung dar dang / mched grogs dad ldan dran tshe gnyis/ 'di 'dra dgos zhes bskul bar bstan (brten/)rang 'dra rmong (rmongs) blun mi rdor gyis/ gyer ri'i gsang phug gsang rdzong du/ dad ldan 'ga' la dran pa yab srasakyi khrid dang / rdzogs chen kyi khrid 'chad skabs thun mtshams su sbyar ba/ 'gro rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i sar 'khod shog
